issue.title: Site settings stay stale in other Worker isolates after a change, with no time limit, so purged pages are rebuilt with the old settings
issue.body:
### Description

`getSiteSettings()` (`packages/core/src/settings/index.ts`) caches settings with `singleFlightCached`, which keeps the value "for the lifetime of the JS global scope" (the isolate, on Workers). A settings write calls `invalidateSiteSettingsCache()`, which bumps the version of the writing isolate's cache only. Every other warm isolate keeps the old settings until Cloudflare recycles it. There is no TTL and no cross-isolate signal. With `kvCache()` configured the object cache is invalidated by epoch, but the single-flight layer above it still returns the old value without consulting it.

The route cache makes this visible. Since #2618 a settings change purges its cache tag, but a purged page can then be rebuilt by an isolate holding the old settings, and that rebuild is cached until the next purge or expiry. #3488 (route-cache fills read from the database) doesn't reach it, because the settings read never gets past the in-isolate cache.

What we saw on a production site (emdash 1.0.1, Cloudflare Workers, Workers Cache through `cacheCloudflare()`, no object cache), after setting `seo.googleVerification`:

- Every cache-busted render (`/?v=<random>`) carried `<meta name="google-site-verification">`, and so did other cached pages (`/about/`, `/whats-on/`, `/blog/`).
- The cached home page kept being rebuilt without it. More than 15 minutes after the change it was served with `age: 38`, so rebuilt after the purge, and still had no tag. It did have `seo.defaultOgImage`, set a few hours earlier, so the isolate's copy of the settings came from between the two writes.

Search engine verification is where this bites: Search Console fetches the page, and a tag missing from a cached page can fail verification or a later re-check. Any other setting a page renders (title, tagline, logo, social links) lags the same way.

Redirects had the same shape and were fixed in #2408, which bounds per-isolate staleness to 30 seconds with a TTL and a generation check (`redirects/cache.ts`, `REDIRECT_CACHE_TTL_MS`). The same treatment for settings would bound the lag. #876 is the same class for the admin manifest. Alternatively the single-flight value could be keyed to the object cache's settings epoch when an object cache is configured.

The code is unchanged on `main` as of 2026-09-30.

### Steps to reproduce

1. A site on Cloudflare Workers with Workers Cache (`cacheCloudflare()`), enough traffic to keep several isolates warm.
2. Change a site setting that pages render, e.g. `seo.googleVerification` in the admin's SEO settings or with the MCP `settings_update` tool.
3. Fetch a page repeatedly with a cache-busting query: renders that land on the isolate that handled the write show the new value; others can show the old one.
4. Fetch the same page without a query after its cached copy is refreshed: it can be rebuilt, and cached, with the old value, well after the change.

### Environment

- emdash 1.0.1, @emdash-cms/cloudflare 1.0.1
- Astro 7.3.2, @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.1, Cloudflare Workers with D1, Workers Cache, no `objectCache`
- Code checked on `main` at 2026-09-30

### Screenshots

Not applicable.

### Logs / error output

```
$ curl -s "https://<site>/?v=1234" | grep -c google-site-verification
1
$ curl -sD - https://<site>/ -o page.html | grep -i '^age'; grep -c google-site-verification page.html
age: 38
0
```
